BrochureContent.Content:
Kelly Hudson Properties proudly present this spacious 5 bedroom detached property located within a much sought after location on the edge of the Curragh plains. The property is located just a 4 minute drive from the M7 Curragh junction, 5 minute walk to the Curragh and 15 minute walk from Newbridge town centre. 

This fantastic property comes to the market in excellent condition having recently had all doors and windows replaced while the heating system was fully upgraded as recently as 2025 with a new energy efficient Gas boiler, new hot tank and new radiators throughout. There is ample living accommodation which includes hallway, kitchen/dining room, utility room, living room, guest wc and an ensuite bedroom on the ground floor. Upstairs there are four well proportioned bedrooms, the master is ensuite and three of which are fitted with wardrobes and the family bathroom. There is generous off street parking together with landscaped and mature gardens to the front and rear a tiled patio. 

Greenmount Park is Ideally situated on the Green Road and only a short distance from Newbridge Town centre where a host of amenities can be found including primary and secondary schools, creches, shops, restaurants, banks, post office, leading supermarket chains, Whitewater Shopping Centre, Newbridge Silverware and much more. Newbridge has a fantastic bus service and train station making it an ideal choice for any commuter. Access to the motorway is only a stones throw away and The Curragh plains are right on your doorstep ideal for a host of recreational facilities. 

Viewing of this property is highly recommended strictly by prior appointment with Agent only.
